title.en: An Act Amending Certain Items of Republic Acts Numbered Twelve Hundred and Fourteen Hundred Eleven
title.orig: An Act Amending Certain Items of Republic Acts Numbered Twelve Hundred and Fourteen Hundred Eleven

text.en:
Item one hundred two, paragraph m, section two of Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(102) Construction of Home Economics Building, San Vicente (Sur) Barrio School ₱1,000.00"

Items fifty-eight and sixty of paragraph m, group II, section three of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven, are hereby amended to read as follows:
"(58) San Vicente (Sur) Barrio School, Home Economics Building, Iriga Construction ₱3,000.00 "(60) San Nicolas School Building, Completion 1,800.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1956.
